text: VSIP approved to develop $136 million infrastructure project in Da Nang Free Trade Zone

Under Decision No. 5202/QD-UBND of the central Da Nang City, issued on November 12, VSIP will contribute VND705 billion ($2 2.4 million), or 20 percent of the total capital, while the remaining VND2.82 trillion ($10 9 .
7 million), accounting for 80 percent, will be mobilized from credit institutions and other lawful sources.
The project carries a 70-year operating term from the date of land lease approval.
The development will roll out across multiple phases.

Investment preparation and administrative procedures are scheduled from the fourth quarter of 2026 to the fourth quarter of 2027, followed by compensation, site clearance, and clean land handover from the first quarter of 2027 through the third quarter of 2029.

Basic construction, infrastructure development, and operational launch are slated from the fourth quarter of 2027 to the first quarter of 2032, while commercial operations, marketing, and investment promotion are expected to commence in the fourth quarter of 2028.

The investor is required to disburse the entire registered capital within five years from the date of on-site land and water surface handover, while fulfilling all obligations designated for a strategic investor.
Previously, on October 19, the Da Nang People's Committee issued Decision No. 4785/QD-UBND approving the investment policy for Functional Zone No. 7.

Located in Hoa Vang Commune and spanning 276 hectares, the zone is oriented toward manufacturing, logistics, digital technology, information technology, and other activities aligned with the master plan of the Da Nang Free Trade Zone.
